name: netfilter-firewall
description: Parses Linux netfilter (iptables/nftables) LOG lines from kernel syslog: UFW, UniFi gateways (UDM/USG firewall rules with [RULE] DESCR="..." prefixes), and plain iptables logging. Anchors on the fixed 'IN= OUT= [MAC=] SRC= DST=' token sequence; ports, protocol, and rule tag are extracted by derivations.

test_samples.description: UFW block: drop action, ports and protocol extracted
test_samples.input: [UFW BLOCK] IN=eth0 OUT= MAC=aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff:11:22:33:44:55:66:08:00 SRC=203.0.113.50 DST=198.51.100.10 LEN=40 TOS=0x00 PREC=0x00 TTL=244 ID=54321 PROTO=TCP SPT=44455 DPT=23 WINDOW=1024 RES=0x00 SYN URGP=0

test_samples.description: UniFi gateway drop rule with DESCR, -D- classified as drop
test_samples.input: [FW-D-WAN_LOCAL-2001] DESCR="Drop invalid state" IN=eth8 OUT= MAC=aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff:11:22:33:44:55:66:08:00 SRC=203.0.113.77 DST=198.51.100.2 LEN=44 TTL=52 PROTO=TCP SPT=51234 DPT=443

test_samples.description: UniFi gateway accept rule on internal traffic, -A- classified as accept
test_samples.input: [FW-A-LAN_LOCAL-2011] DESCR="Allow established" IN=br0 OUT= MAC=aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff:aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff:08:00 SRC=192.168.1.10 DST=192.168.1.1 LEN=60 PROTO=UDP SPT=5353 DPT=5353

metadata.author: siembox
metadata.log_source: Linux kernel netfilter LOG target (UFW, UniFi UDM/USG, iptables/nftables) via syslog
